name: Khemia
storyline:
A village gripped by fear. A little kid. Alchemy.

Twenty years have passed since the incident. No one talks about it, but everyone knows. Oti is a little kid who lives ignoring the truth, he just wants to help his friend who got hurt, but his momma told him he can do no good by picking flowers in the forest. However, as a little kid he is, he ignores his mother’s words to get what he wants and suddenly… he turns into a goat! The curse is upon him!

To help little Oti get his human body back, you will guide him through the alchemist tower while kicking (literally) the enemies of the room and playing puzzles in a cauldron. This element will help Oti to navigate through different levels the alchemist has prepared, to ensure you escape to the next floor, move around the rooms and get the orb to open the door.

But beware! A shadow will follow Oti to ensure you both fail!
summary: Khemia is a 2D puzzle-platformer with a technological medieval fantasy theme where you play Oti, a little kid who mysteriously has been turned into a goat. The game takes place inside the alchemist's tower, yes, the one who turned our little guy into a goat. You will have to jump, kick, dash and ram the enemies who will block your path!
